ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Services in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the poor policy language that may have cost Minnesota $1.7B across 14 Medicaid services
questions: What were the specific policy language issues that led to the financial losses?
How can Minnesota prevent similar losses in the future?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant financial losses and highlight the need for clear policy language in Medicaid services. By analyzing data and interviewing experts, we can shed light on this critical issue.
